steps.content:
23 Hours After Jasmine's Escape

WhiteSands
The Bureau's armored pursuit vehicle tears through the pale expanse of WhiteSands. The ash density hasn't eased, the sandstorm hasn't broken, and together they bleed the speed from your chase.
You can only hope it drags Jasmine down just as much, that it keeps her from reaching Nirvana Port so quickly.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Chief! We've got the transport driver on the line. He never saw who hit him, woke up on the side of the road with the truck dead. He's less than 30 klicks from Nirvana Port.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Those Rancor blades are gone.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Is she at the port yet? Has she made it? Chief, I keep calling but the Shattered Blade won't pick up—

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Jasmine escaped? That... that doesn't make any sense. She's been doing so well, taking her meds, fully engaged in rehab. If something was seriously wrong, there's no way she could've kept up that act. Where... where did she go?

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: A madwoman with her wits intact... That level of intelligence, that will... it only makes her more absolute in rejecting any attempt to reach her heart. She's far more dangerous than we gave her credit for. It's... it's just tragic.
[WhiteSands Background, Nighttime] Screen Shakes, Driving Scene

Inside the vehicle, you're seething with frustration. This is your 16th attempt to contact Nirvana Port through the heavy communication interference; this time, it finally goes through. A cold voice answers from the other end.

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: Hello.

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: She is here, with her blades. This is your idea of returning that Rancor?
A storm of noise rises in the background. You catch the clash of metal, the bark of gunfire, and from some far-off place, barely audible—

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Hahaha...
It's Jasmine! Your heart clenches in an instant.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Stop her, please! There has to be something at the port! Augustus must know some way to contain Rancors! Just get those blades off Jasmine. Separate her from them. They're the ones in control, not her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm almost there. The shackles can calm her. She'll listen to me. She still has her mind. She can still be saved.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Jasmine isn't DisCity's enemy. She's a civilian. She's innocent! Uris, don't hurt her!
You beg him, your words tumbling out near-incoherent, but all you get back is the coldest possible reply.

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: That's not our problem. If she wants to make herself the enemy of the Shattered Blade, we've got standing orders for enemies.

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: Pick up the pace, Chief. Show up now, and you might still catch the closing act.
The line goes dead. A curse tears out of you, raw with fury, as you dial the next number, then another, reaching for every name you can think of.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Nightingale, get me FAC, or EDGE, or Ring Research, anyone! Put a leash on the Shattered Blade! Get them ordered to stand down!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Banyan Medical, sedatives, high-potency sedatives, whatever they've got! Authorization for high-level Sinner deployment, now! Don't let them slow me down! Hello? Hello?! Can you hear me?! Damn it!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: <size=50>Eugene, faster!!</size>

Over quicksand, through the storm's lashing heart, the armored pursuit vehicle at last breaks into the eye and barrels through Nirvana Port's guardrails like a thing possessed. You boot open the scarred and splintered door, stepping out to meet the guards closing in to inspect.

And to your surprise, they do as you say. One look at you, and understanding settles over their faces. Someone opens their mouth, then thinks better of it. They clear a path and let you through. The weight of it only deepens the dread coiling in your gut.

You storm into Nirvana Port. Alarms howl along every turn, security measures slamming shut in sequence, yet it feels orchestrated, a baiting trail. The path is littered with fresh, brutal slash marks, drawing you toward the heart of the fortress.

Jasmine's unhinged laughter echoes amid the gunfire and the ringing clash of metal. You cannot tell if it is near, if it bleeds through the shackles, or if your imagination has finally broken its leash. Before your eyes, fragments of nightmare unspool.
[Main Story CG - Suffering Hella]
[War CG Montage]
[War CG Montage]
[War CG Montage]
[Final Flash: Two CGs of Jasmine Being Taken Away]
[Final Flash: Two CGs of Jasmine Being Taken Away]

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There's still time... I have to make it!
[Black Screen, Sound of Door Being Rammed]
You burst from the cramped passage onto an open-air platform. The sky is dark, but one glance down and you see her.
There, Jasmine stands in the center of a clearing. She's unhurt, but exhaustion weighs on every line of her frame. She sways on her feet, her long hair and dress soaked in a vivid, glaring red.
It's not her blood.

steps.speaker: Soldier
steps.content: Cough... Ahh!!

At her feet and all around her, soldiers lie fallen. Five, six, seven of them, breath shallow, life fading. The ground is strewn with the shattered fragments of Rancors. From the broken edges, the masterless Mania leaks forth, mingling with blood, spreading slow across the earth.

Farther back, a dozen or so Shattered Blade soldiers stand in loose knots, their faces etched with bone-deep weariness. Weapons in hand, yet they do not stir—spectators or corpses, it is impossible to tell—jutting stark and strange in the hush of this quiet arena.
At center stage, Jasmine trembles. She laughs, a frail sound spiraling steadily into madness.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Heh... hehe... Ahahahahahaha! So weak... SO WEAK!!

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Is this all DisCity's blades can do? Rusted out? Gone dull? Every last one of you, so pathetic! Lining up one by one, just begging me to snap you in half?!

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: You wish! That celebration isn't over. Now it's your turn to take the stage, and just bleeding won't cut it!

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Cry! Scream! Get on your knees and beg. We've been through all that! Pick up your weapons! Keep going!

She cries out, raising one of her blood-drenched Rancor blades and leveling it at the "audience" a few meters away. Where the blade points, no fire of rage ignites. The soldiers remain eerily calm, and from among them, another figure steps forward.

steps.speaker: Soldier
steps.content: ...My turn.

He hefts his axe, accepting the "duel." In an instant, Jasmine's drained body ignites again. The Rancor blades drag her forward, hurling her at her opponent as she hacks down on him like a raging storm.
Stop them. They must be stopped. Your feet stir into motion, but no sooner do you turn than a hand lands hard upon your shoulder, barring the way.

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: Careful, Chief.

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: This is a fight between Rancors. At this point, walking in means death. The General sees something in you. I'm to keep you breathing.

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: Not that you'd stop them anyway.
Isn't this on him too?! Fury rises to your lips, but before the words can break, your eyes catch what Iron Mask carries on his other side.
A veteran soldier, his body half-drowned in blood, arms and legs swaying with the lifeless weight of the unconscious. From his collar, a rusted dog tag slips free, bearing a name—
He's beyond saving. This is Jasmine's vengeance; this is the brutal battlefield you've relived countless times in your nightmares. But what truly shakes you goes deeper than that.

When you look at Arkin's face, you see no hatred, no pain, no fear, no regret. There's just an eerie smile, hollow and desolate like the stillness of ruins. You then turn your gaze at the Shattered Blade soldiers below, only to find them wear the same expression.

Challenger and onlooker alike, none of them mean to kill her. No fear, no fury, no resignation. They simply watch and wait, as if the figure before them isn't an enemy who slaughtered their comrades, but something else entirely. Kin, at last recognizing each other.
The bizarre inversion of it sends a wave of dizziness through you.

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: You don't get it? Of course you don't. In this world, only Rancor understands Rancor. We understand her hatred. A life for a life, simple as that.

His words are cold, his gaze fixed on the scene below. In the arena, the two Rancors launch into another charge. Jasmine's Mania spills from her blades, shrieking as she drives forward. The soldier on the other side surges to meet her with gathered force, his face still utterly calm.

Just as her blades are about to crash against his axe, with half a step between them, he looks into Jasmine's eyes and suddenly smiles. The same smile as Arkin's. He opens his mouth and murmurs, barely audible.

steps.speaker: Soldier
steps.content: You... did good.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Ahhh!!!

The instant their weapons meet, the Mania on his axe gutters out. Jasmine's blade shears straight through the soldier's weapon and into his body. Blood sprays into the dancer's eyes. She reels back several steps, her shock blasting through the shackles straight to the top of your skull.
And then you hear it too: the resonance of the Rancors echoing through her mind, and theirs.

steps.speaker: Rancors
steps.content: It's from RNH... I remember now... No, don't remember. I've seen people like that before I've hurt people like that before. They're coming to stir up trouble again they're finally here to collect what's owed.

steps.speaker: Rancors
steps.content: Don't feel sorry for her don't hurt her. We're not done hating yet we've done enough evil already. I stayed alive for today I kept breathing for this. Time to settle every score that was left open...

steps.speaker: Rancors
steps.content: Back to the fight back to the fight back to the fight back to the fight back to the fight back to the fight back to the fight back to the fight back to the fight back to the fight BACK TO THE FIGHT!

Accumulated derangement, the longing for death... Under Mania's influence, they curdle into a frenzy that denies everything. The impact knocks you off balance. Iron Mask catches you before you fall. Yet the soldiers, Iron Mask included, remain utterly still, their faces expressionless, as if they'd seen this coming all along.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Are those Rancors... brainwashing them? Or do they actually want...

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: There aren't many DisCorps soldiers left alive. They've been running on fumes a long time now, held on 'til Augustus came, held on 'til now... Truth is, most of them ran out of fight a while back. If anything, we should be the ones thanking you.

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: Thank you for delivering us a spotless victim. You proved her innocence. Laid bare the weight of their sins. Handed them the perfect judge to send them all to hell.
...Judge? Perfect? Meaning... both sides get exactly what they want?
The deathly numbness in his voice sets your blood on fire.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Are you kidding me?! There's only Arkin left from RNH. What do the rest of them down there have to do with Jasmine? What, you're all going to relive their traumas together? Run the past back, swap the ending, and call that atonement?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: To hell with that! You just can't put down the Rancors. Spent your whole lives blind to everything but the battlefield. If the guilt's eating you alive, then march your asses to a military court and face a real verdict! She is not your way out. This is just more torture for her!

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: Waking up is the torture!

His metal prosthetic pins you against the narrow corridor railing, the force nearly wrenching your arm out of its socket. Through that cold iron mask, you feel his anger, something you've rarely ever sensed from him.

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: You pulled her out of cryosleep, stood there running your mouth about bringing her back to the living. When you did all that, did you ever stop and think how she's supposed to live on?

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: Dragging a ghost back takes a lot. If you can't keep at it and you can't tame her, then let her go. None of us can stop her. So just watch, Chief.
The Mania markings on his neck smolder with a pent-up burn, and his Mania bleeds into you. Rage, hatred, agony, obsession—a torrent of violent emotion, and none of it is meant for you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...You can't keep at it, and you can't tame them. You believe these soldiers of yours can never come back, so you're letting them go... You made this decision by yourself...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Or are you doing this while she's gone, to settle old scores before she returns?
At last, a ripple cuts across the stagnant water.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Heh... There it is. You can't face her. You don't want her stained by the sins from your past. You want to keep her in the light. You think she's like you. That she couldn't carry it either.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...So this is how you look after her soldiers, <color=#fb9259>Adjutant</color>.
You say your piece. Then, with little resistance, you shoulder past him and rush down.
[Scene Change: Jasmine's Portrait]
Another "enemy" falls, but Jasmine has no time to celebrate. She stumbles backward, hunched over, frantically scrubbing at her eyes as if the blood were acid instead. She's whimpering, trembling.

She's terrified. Through the blood haze, the soldiers of DisCity close in around her, with weapons in hand, but no intent to kill. Calm madmen lining up to bare their necks. For the first time, they truly frighten her.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: ...Again... It's happening again!! You have weapons. Why won't you fight?! Are you insane?!
Silence is her only answer, save for the Rancors' resonating whispers, swelling ever more rabid in her mind.

steps.speaker: Rancors
steps.content: Go on. Don't stop now. Who's next? Do us this honor. We can be your enemy too. We've all walked the same battlefield.

steps.speaker: Rancors
steps.content: This is what you wanted this is what we prayed for. We hate you we know how you feel. Go on. We're all the same.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Drop the act! You've always wanted me dead, haven't you?! Then come on! I'm standing right here! Come at me!
She's nearly breaking under the weight of those whispers. Just then, she hears the one voice that's real.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Chief...?!
She thinks she's hearing things until she looks up and sees you. Joy ignites her face for an instant, then gutters out just as fast.
The moment she realizes you've entered the battlefield too, your foot setting down on the spreading blood, her expression turns ashen. Jasmine snaps her blades up and screams at you to stop.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Not one more step! I'm having fun. Don't ruin this for me...

She attempts a savage, mocking smile, but it reveals nothing save her own collapse. The battle has dragged on too long; her strength and will are both nearly spent. Even her voice comes out trembling.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: ...Why did you come here, you fool... It's dangerous, and this has nothing to do with you. How many times have I lied to you now, and you still worry about me?

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: But you don't have to. I'm strong now, not like last time. I won't lose again... See? I've already won.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Once I've swept the stage clean, I'll come back. You can punish me then, okay?

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Just wait a little longer... The celebration's almost over. All of DisCity's blades are here, every last one... I'll finish it soon. Just have to break them all...
She looks around. Yes, this is her celebration, taken back at last. Look, everyone's so happy. Everyone but ${PlayerName}.

Fallen at her feet or waiting in silence, some of them wear fresh uniforms, some in clothes worn thin by time. Even faces from years back have come, all of them an audience who once watched her dance.

From that first celebration to this one, every last person has been bleeding, bearing blades, watching her with smiles. She scans each face—the living, the dead—all of them knowing this is the finale. Jasmine wants to smile too, but...

One by one, slashes and bloodied scars grow on those smiling faces. The faces of "enemies" and the faces of her people slip apart and slide together. The blades in her hand burn. The gleeful celebration song dissolves into keening. Suddenly, she cannot see how long the road ahead truly is, how much longer she must walk before the celebration ends.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: ...Why are there so many... It's still not over? How much longer... Do I have to kill every last one?

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: My celebration... is this really what it was?

Jasmine's smile crumbles, her spirit suspended on a gossamer thread. For more than ten years, she confronted the wound without flinching, and now she stands at last at the source of it all, only to find the awakened past flaying her inch by inch.
As though her pursuit had never been about righting what was wrong. As though what they hunted, all along, was only the death the battlefield had long owed the ones who lived.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No... this isn't right... You don't want this. Killing only hurts you... You just wanted to protect your celebration. You wanted to break the blade that destroyed your home...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Put the blades down. Please. This fight is not giving you anything but more pain. The nightmare can end. We'll find another way. Destroy the Rancor for good. Hold the guilty to account. See a real celebration...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Come back with me, will you? Don't let the thing that hurt you destroy you all over again... It shouldn't end like this...

You call her name softly, walking toward her through the weight of Mania and the reek of blood. But the eyes Jasmine turns on you hold nothing but hollow confusion. You're the only outsider here. Every one of her "enemies," every "foe" here, is closer to her heart than you are.

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: You pulled her out of cryosleep, stood there running your mouth about bringing her back to the living. When you did all that, did you ever stop and think how she's supposed to live on?

What's left that could still ignite something in her? Justice, happiness, a future—things already stripped from her, denied beyond reach. Do they hold any value anymore? What could possibly make her turn and look back toward this shore? You wrack your brain, your skull pounding.
Then, as if pitying your desperation, someone behind you brings the answer.
[Black Screen]

steps.speaker: Voice From Behind
steps.content: You started a fight and didn't invite me?
[Transition 2s]
Familiar footsteps. A familiar voice. It's someone you know well.
This time, there isn't the faintest trace of a smile on her face.
[Silhouette Transitions to Augustus's Portrait]
The general strides past you, and in that moment, you are frozen where you stand, your body gone cold. The dozen or so Shattered Blade soldiers ahead are no different.
At last, their gazes pull free of Jasmine, only to flinch away from their commander by instinct.
The one they answer to has returned. A pall of fear settles over them all.

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: ...Why did you come back?

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Got an emergency call. Nirvana Port's in trouble, they said. Told me to get back now. I didn't think I'd come home to... this.

An expression you have never seen before rests on Augustus's face. She takes in the scene: a manic Outlands Sinner, debris and remains littering the ground, Rancor after Rancor broken open and bleeding corruption.
At last her gaze finds you. A single glance at your expression tells her all she needs to know. She laughs, cold.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Chief ${PlayerName}'s right. This fight means nothing. A waste of breath.
A handful of soldiers who followed her back step quickly between you, shielding you and shutting you out at once. You try to speak, but her eyes never return to you.
Augustus turns toward Jasmine.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: If it's revenge you want, at least point it at the right target.

Jasmine's entire body jolts. The confusion and vulnerability she showed you only moments earlier have vanished. From the moment Augustus entered, her gaze has been fixed on the general. A smile reclaims the dancer's face.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Heh... I knew it. This whole thing felt off... because you weren't here.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Should've just said so. All I need to do is kill you. So let's—Nngh!

She lunges to attack, only for her twin blades to wrench hard in the opposite direction, tangling her stride. She knows this force at once. It's Augustus's magnetic field manipulation, the same power she witnessed at the Great Expo.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Let go of me, coward! What's wrong? You scared? Scared to fight me?!

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Fight you? Heh... Stray cats really don't learn. Have you forgotten already? At the Great Expo, when I used my power, you couldn't even last a minute.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Besides, I don't waste my time on fools who let their own blades puppet them around. You want to face me? Then clear your head and come at me like a real warrior.
She steps through her subordinate's blood and enters the inner circle, studying Jasmine with cold scrutiny.
Then Augustus lifts her still-sheathed sword and levels it at the enraged dancer.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Rein in your Mania, Outlander. You follow the rules, and I'll give you my word. No powers, a fair duel with just this sword. Which means...

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: You might actually get a shot at my head.

Iron Mask and every Shattered Blade soldier stiffen at once. But Augustus doesn't spare them a single glance. Her eyes stay fixed on the blood-crazed Sinner before her, a smile of pure contempt spreading across her face.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Unless, of course, you're too afraid to face me without <color=#fb9259>DisCity's Rancor</color> doing all the work.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Heh... Hehe... Ahahaha! You snake! Fine, come on! I'll gnaw you to death with my own teeth if I have to!
Jasmine speaks through clenched teeth, but the wild Rancor in her grip slowly begins to subside. Something in Augustus's eyes eases, just a fraction.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: ...There we go. Now show me what you've got.
The two S-Class Sinners lock eyes. Their powers gradually recede, suppressed by the weight of a greater will. The raging Mania around them quiets, and everyone holds their breath.

The instant the magnetic field lifts, Jasmine launches forward like a bullet. Her blades slice past Augustus's face, only to be guided aside by the DisCity general's sword. In a smooth deflection, it slides and turns her strike away.
(Production note: Record several battle sound effects, edit as needed, and sync to corresponding narration. This line should be deleted from final version.)

Chop, slash, sweep, thrust. Jasmine's attacks are ferocious and blunt, reckless with abandon. In a few exchanges, Augustus has caught her rhythm. A casual feint, a flick of her cloak, and Jasmine takes the bait.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Ugh!
Duped by the sweep of the cloak, Jasmine staggers and crashes to the earth. The first exchange is done. For all her fury, her claws have not once grazed the composed hunter before her.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Get up. Again.

Her tone of command only stokes the flames higher. Jasmine's eyes burn red as she springs up and surges forward again. The second round begins: their movements now too swift to follow, only crimson phantoms flickering around Augustus's form. Metal shrieks against metal in rapid, stinging bursts, sparks flashing through the air like lightning.

Augustus will not be broken; she is the perfect target for vengeance. At last, Jasmine can pour out her fury without restraint. The battle climbs in intensity, and the atmosphere among the Shattered Blade soldiers presses down heavier with each beat.

Not long ago, they hung their heads in silence, awaiting Jasmine's execution. Now their beloved general is threatened, and their hands tighten once more around their Rancors. Murderous intent seeps through the ranks, but Augustus pays it no heed.

She reads the stillness inside the storm and thrusts with precision, striking Jasmine clean in the chest. Jasmine lets out a violent cough and staggers back, her berserk offensive collapsing with a single hit. The blade, even now, remains sheathed.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Go on.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: GAAAAAHHHHHH—!!!

Another round, and another. Her attacks descend like a frenzied storm, only to be broken, again and again, by the simplest slash as metal shrieks its lament with every blow. A spent assassin on the edge of ruin hurls herself against a composed general fresh from her victorious return.

Murderous rage and hatred devour the last of her strength, ignited into a blaze until at last, the fire burns itself out. Jasmine drops to her knees, staring in confusion at the Rancor in her hands. Nothing remains but exhaustion, defeat, and a hollow void.
Augustus's shadow falls over her. The "enemy" is overwhelmingly strong. Jasmine couldn't wound this woman, not even a scratch.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: ...Can't break... her blade... I can't break it...

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Why...

This is the second time. How many years have passed? The beginning of everything, the fount of all her suffering, stands here before her now. A chain of cause and consequence this long ought to have its end. The celebration's close requires this woman's severed head to mark its grave, and yet Jasmine cannot lay a finger on her.
...And still she is made to suffer that gaze from on high.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Are we done? Or take a breath and keep going?

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: ...Hahaha... Is this some kind of joke? I'm not a joke... None of us is a joke...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Jasmine, don't...
Her breathing grows ragged and disordered. Her fragile mind can no longer hold the Mania back. It seeps through the widening cracks, and the Rancor blades begin to thrum with a low, pulsing hum.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: It's not meaningless... I came all this way, I made it here... I survived for the celebration, and it's not over yet...
Augustus studies Jasmine without a word. Her eyes drift past the dancer's shoulder to you, then settle on the fallen soldiers strewn across the ground. A sigh escapes her, nearly imperceptible.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Last chance. Put the blades down, or I'll break them for you.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: ...You're the one who should be broken!

The Rancor is set loose. In that moment, she wants nothing but to bring down the woman before her. She gives herself willingly to the blades, becoming their puppet. The duel collapses, her power spirals out of control, and years of bottled madness erupt in a roaring surge toward Augustus.

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: General!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Jasmine, no!!!

In the same breath, the Shattered Blade soldiers erupt into motion. A dozen fighters with a dozen weapons surge to Augustus's side as one, pushing forward to meet the crazed Outlander. They know killing her means damnation, but they do not waver for a second. Gunfire cracks through the air.
The Rancors decided their own end long ago.
[Black Screen]
Yet the death match never ignites.
There is no bloodshed, no collision. Every blade and bullet hangs suspended in the air, their wielders locked motionless alongside them.
A crushing magnetic power commands the field. Augustus stands at the center between the two frenzied forces, surrounded by Rancor weapons hovering in stillness. The quiet that falls is absolute.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: I said a fair duel. Are all of you deaf...? You dare defy my order?

Her magnetic power wrenches the weapons and flings them hard, throwing the berserk combatants to the earth. If this ground is a battlefield, it must kneel to her command. Her patience has at last run dry, and she wields terror to drive reason back into them.
The battle between the Rancor wielders is over. You can rest easy now. Except...
Just now, Augustus wasn't the only one trying to stop the fight.
[Shackles Effect]

Your hand is outstretched, a harsh red light blazing from it, aimed at the center of the battlefield. Both S-Class Sinners turn to look at you at once. In that most perilous moment, you released the shackles on pure instinct. But the shackles can only bind one person at a time.
And the person you restrained is—
The red light of the shackles cuts through Augustus. She holds steady, unshaken, yet even so, this grants Jasmine her first, and only, chance.
One of the curved blades sweeps across the DisCity general's shoulder, a strand of her hair falling away. Blood slowly surfaces, darkening the fabric of her epaulette.
Jasmine, too, stands frozen.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Haha... Haha... You deserved that... You deserved it...

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: I'm not alone. I have Chief on my side. As long as he's here, I won't lose. Chief, I—
steps.female_content: I'm not alone. I have Chief on my side. As long as she's here, I won't lose. Chief, I—

steps.content: She never meant to drag you into this. She's always kept you out of her battlefield. But now that you've truly barged in, she realizes that she's so happy. So impossibly happy. She doesn't yet understand this feeling. She just wants to turn around and look at you.
Then, in a heartbeat, all that joy twists into a scream of horror.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: NOOO!!
[Violent impact, screen shakes, bone-breaking sound effect]
You're thrown down from behind. Your arm twists into a grotesque angle, searing pain tearing through every nerve. The hand that unleashed the shackles goes instantly numb.
You turn your head and meet Iron Mask's bloodshot, red-rimmed eyes.

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: ...You use the shackles on her again, I'll snap your neck.

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: Now shut your mouth!

You are pressed ruthlessly into the earth. White sand mingled with blood fills your mouth and nostrils; no restraining order can leave your lips now. Barely meters beyond, more than a dozen muzzles turn as one and train themselves on you. Behind each sight, eyes seethe with rage.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: No! He has nothing to do with this! I'm the one you want. Let him go!! Nngh—!
steps.female_content: No! She has nothing to do with this! I'm the one you want. Let her go!! Nngh—!

steps.content: Steel plates and iron bars bear down on her with crushing weight. Even the twin blades in her hands twist into restraints, flipping around to lock the Outland Sinner firmly in place.
It's that person's power.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Let him go, Uris. All of you, stand down.
steps.female_content: Let her go, Uris. All of you, stand down.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: ...Leave him to me.
The weight pinning you down lifts with obvious reluctance, but you can't rise anyway. Pain and blood loss keep you flattened against the ground. You hear slow footsteps approaching.
That most dependable "comrade" who once fought at your side picks up her sword. Despite the shackles, she walks toward you, step by step.
Jasmine struggles desperately, but it's useless. Augustus doesn't spare her a single backward glance. The general has abandoned her old foe and now stands before you.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: ...Your arm's broken... Does it hurt?

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: How could you be so foolish? Using the shackles on me here... You really could've gotten yourself killed.

You understand. Shackling the commander, becoming a clear threat to her, is the Shattered Blade's greatest taboo. The trust you've shared exists only because you fought side by side through the direst of circumstances.
And that instinctive move you just made shattered it completely. The Shattered Blade never spares an enemy of Augustus.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You said you didn't want the battlefield defiled. You wanted to return honor to Shattered Blade.
Hearing this, Augustus smiles.
She's glad you remember those words. But the shackles are still on her, which means you don't truly trust her.
...Then let it be that way. Augustus closes her eyes. When she opens them again—

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Honor...? You mean mercy? Justice? Righteousness? Kindness, understanding, seeing the other side's pain... No. That's you. That's who you are.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: You're such a fool, Chief... Who talks about conscience to a war?
There is something wrong with her expression. You try to ask, but a deafening boom interrupts. Several lengths of steel rebar graze past your body and drive deep into the earth.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Chief!!
Augustus doesn't look back. After all this time, she finally draws that sword, her eyes fixed on you, yet every word she speaks drives clean into Jasmine's nerves.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: I am a general of the DisCorps, commander of every last Rancor. What they do, all of it, is on my orders. If I had a shred of mercy in me, that woman wouldn't be out here right now, hunting vengeance like some rabid dog.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: So you don't want her dead? Then why did you let her onto the battlefield? Why did you stand by while she provoked me? Were you just hoping for the best? Can you afford the price if you're wrong? Or is it that her life doesn't really matter to you?

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: But it does matter, doesn't it? You even used your shackles against me, just to protect her...

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Good. This is easier. Treating you as an enemy makes things much simpler...
Augustus turns slightly, glancing at the blades in Jasmine's hands, then at Jasmine herself. A chill crawls down Jasmine's spine for no reason she can name.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: That Rancor says you never left that celebration. That it's still going, even now. Then allow me to... liven the mood.
She slides the sword through your hair, the edge shearing away a few strands, then draws it slowly across your throat. Jasmine's pupils blow wide in an instant.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Don't worry... I'll make it quick.

steps.speaker: Rest in peace, monster.
steps.content: ...ARRRGGHHH!!

A fire catches within Jasmine. She struggles like a woman possessed, pouring all her remaining strength into breaking loose. The blades forgotten, she hurls herself past Augustus and throws her body in front of yours as a living shield.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Jasmine...

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: No... You can't let her... She's insane. She's a monster... She means it...

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: ...It's happening again. It always happens... I shouldn't have let you come. I should've driven you away the second I saw you... Not again. I can't let it happen again. I can't lose you too...

Her whole body shakes. For too long, far too long, war and enemies meant nothing but vengeance in her eyes. So long that she'd forgotten what they truly were at the beginning: absolute <color=#fb9259>fear</color>.

The fear of being stripped of everything. The fear of losing what she loves. It all comes rushing back now, vivid and visceral, a chaotic mess churning through her mind. She shields you desperately, clinging to you the way she once held onto those she couldn't keep, unwilling to move even a single step away.
Augustus doesn't move. At some point, her sword found its sheath again. She stands a single step away, watching the two of you. In the end, she doesn't take that short step.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: ...There. That's better. Hate me. Fear me. When the killing urge comes, come find me. But only challenge me when you're ready to lose everything. That's the attitude war demands. No more fooling yourself with hope.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Pitiful Rancor. I am your one commander, and your one enemy. I will give you everything you seek. Even death, if that's truly what you want.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: But be clear about this... There are more than just enemies on the battlefield. There are also fools like him, clinging to you, refusing to let go. He threw himself in front of me for you this time. But if he does it again, I promise you, his end will not be gentle.
steps.female_content: But be clear about this... There are more than just enemies on the battlefield. There are also fools like her, clinging to you, refusing to let go. She threw herself in front of me for you this time. But if she does it again, I promise you, her end will not be gentle.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: You vile bastard... shameless coward... If you lay a finger on him...
steps.female_content: You vile bastard... shameless coward... If you lay a finger on her...

steps.content: She curses helplessly. The woman she hates most has already turned away, walking back toward her troops. Her back is wide open, every cell in Jasmine's body screaming at her to charge and run her through.

But the body in Jasmine's arms is going cold. He's badly hurt. Jasmine presses frantically at the wound to stop the bleeding, and in her panic, ${PlayerName}'s face blurs with the faces of her people. She can't breathe. Her heart pounds like a war drum as if she's alive again, truly alive.
steps.female_content: But the body in Jasmine's arms is going cold. She's badly hurt. Jasmine presses frantically at the wound to stop the bleeding, and in her panic, ${PlayerName}'s face blurs with the faces of her people. She can't breathe. Her heart pounds like a war drum as if she's alive again, truly alive.

steps.content: War stripped everything from her. Justice, happiness, love, a future, all ground to dust. Everything she once believed in was denied, annihilated. But war gave her one thing, carved into the marrow of her bones: the pain and fear of loss.
That is it. Only through taking, and being taken from, can a Rancor's heart truly awaken.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Don't you dare think you've won!! I'll kill you. I swear I'll kill you one day!!

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: When you're truly ready to let go of everything... anytime. I'll be waiting.
Augustus moves forward without a single backward glance. As she passes the abandoned pair of Rancor blades, she raises her hand and breaks them apart.
Then she walks toward her silent soldiers and leads them back into the shadow of their bastion.
The crimson light from the shackles cuts through Jasmine, breaking her assault and crushing the Rancor's corruption in one clean stroke.
Reason has returned to her. She keeps her head bowed, every inch of her shaking.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Do you hate me now, Chief? Because I... wouldn't listen?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...No. I could never hate you, Jasmine.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: You don't hate me? Then why...

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: ...Because... you're taking her side?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm not taking anyone's side. But Jasmine... I can't watch you suffer like this anymore.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't let the Rancor take you. Don't let it destroy you again. Come back with me. We can—
You try to move closer, your voice earnest and pleading, desperate to soothe her. But your words can no longer reach her.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Haha... I knew it. I knew it! All the same... I'm such a fool. You're all the same...
Augustus is the first to sense something wrong. Killing intent. Her hand closes around the hilt of her sword, every muscle going taut.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: ...Enough. ${PlayerName}, get out. Now—

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Uris, get him out of here!
steps.female_content: Uris, get her out of here!

steps.content: But it's too late. Jasmine turns and looks at you. This time, finally, her heart and her eyes hold you, and only you.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: I SHOULD HAVE KILLED YOU FIRST!!

She spins around, dragging the Rancor blades with her and turning them on you. Hatred and despair far heavier than vengeance erupt alongside her Mania, and somehow she breaks free of both Augustus's control and the shackles.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, move!!
Augustus draws her sword and thrusts straight at the crazed Jasmine, dropping every last trace of hesitation and mercy.
But Jasmine's blades are faster, more desperate. She charges at you from less than ten steps away.
Five steps. The killing intent hits you like a physical force. She means it. You can see the hatred in her eyes with absolute clarity.

steps.speaker: Soldier
steps.content: No... hold your fire! Too close, we'll hit the Chief!
Three paces. The wind off her blades stings your nerves. Your body finally registers death's warning, only for raw fear to seize you and lock every muscle in place.

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: Move! ${PlayerName}!!
You can't die on her blades. Not here. You throw every ounce of strength into retreat, forcing your body backward, desperate to gain even a single step of distance. You have to move, for everyone!
You manage it. Then, at once, regret floods in.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Cough!
A rapier pierces through her body.
It's Augustus.

She seizes the opening, that single step you fought so desperately to create. With you finally clear, she unleashes her power. Two steel lances shoot in from opposite sides, impaling Jasmine's hands and completely neutralizing the strike meant for you. The Shattered Blade soldiers open fire on instinct.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No!!

Before your very eyes, bullets rip through that fragile, shattered body. Not a sound escapes her. Her blades fall from your throat as though, at the very end, she mustered what little strength remained and turned it away from your vital points.
She slides down against you, blood drenching you both. You sink to your knees and hold her. There is no use in calling out now.
The dancer's pupils slowly lose their focus, like scattering fireworks, taking in every Disian's face standing around her.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Hehe... Hahaha... Look... a celebration... a celebration that lasts forever...

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Enjoy it... It's all yours now...
The fireworks scatter into nothing. In death, she binds her enemies to the celebration's eternal curse.
[Black Screen Transition]

General Augustus slew the frenzied avenger with her own hands, saving her soldiers and her ally.

Yet her battlefield lies stained, her blade dishonored. The glory she newly claimed and the vow she made are all reduced to ashes. And you, together with every Rancor soldier standing there, are witnesses to it.
Even years later, it remains a nightmare for all of you. The cursed celebration never ends, not even in death.

Jasmine's blade comes straight for you, but you can't move away. If you take even a single step, Augustus's sword will pierce through this berserk Outland Rancor wielder. She could end everything, but that's not what you want.
The Sinner before you, her eyes wild with rage, was never meant to be here.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: DIE!
Her hatred pierces you before the blades ever do. Somewhere between the pain and the fear, a hazy answer flickers into mind.

She never accepted you. Never wanted to let you in. But now, everything is different. Now, you are her <color=#fb9259>enemy</color>. By truly stepping onto her battlefield, you've finally earned your place.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Stop!!
Trapped on this battlefield, suffering for so long, she's questioned fate over and over, and always received the same answer. But now, perhaps, you can finally give her an answer no "enemy" ever has.
You step forward, reaching out to her, arms open wide. In that moment, Jasmine's eyes go wide.

For the briefest instant, the hatred in her gaze shatters under the force of shock. Then follows a maelstrom of confusion, doubt, terror, resistance, and regret. She can't process it. She tries to pull back, but she's already too close. There's no escaping now.

Momentum carries the twin Rancor blades forward. They slice easily through your coat and bite into skin. The edges carve through flesh, exposing the sinew and bone of your shoulder. Blood spatters across Jasmine's face. Her whole body jolts.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: AAAHHHH!!!
A scream tears from her throat. She flings the Rancor blades away as if they seared her palm. The weapon spins through the air and buries itself deep in the white sand.
At last, you summon every last shred of strength and catch hold of her. No time to register the pain. You pull her tight against you.
Augustus rushes over. Judging by her face, things aren't looking good. But you can't black out now, not after coming this far. Time to strike while the iron's hot.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Let go, ${PlayerName}. She's not someone you can control. Those blades have already marked you as the enemy. Leave this to me. I'll handle both the Rancor and its wielder.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Let her go! She's too far gone. You're going to get yourself killed!
Her enemy's voice is so close, yet Jasmine can no longer make out Augustus's face.
${PlayerName}'s blood keeps pouring out, sticking him and Jasmine together. The metallic stench is overpowering. After all these years, fear finds Jasmine again. She shakes violently.
steps.female_content: ${PlayerName}'s blood keeps pouring out, sticking her and Jasmine together. The metallic stench is overpowering. After all these years, fear finds Jasmine again. She shakes violently.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: ...No... let go... let go of me... why...
Your consciousness blurs at the edges, but the weight in your chest finally eases.
For the first time, you feel you have truly reached her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Haha... It's okay... Everything's okay now... I came to deliver the blades. So... mission accomplished, I guess...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Augustus... Catherine. That Rancor is yours. Take it... Take your soldiers... to a battlefield worthy of real glory.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She doesn't belong on any battlefield... I'm taking her back.
You feel the one in your arms flinch.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Jasmine doesn't belong here. She'll never be your enemy again... And if she needs an enemy... I'll be enough.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: From now on... I'll bear everything she carries.

Your words have struck something deep within her. Augustus makes no answer. She gazes at you both in silence, then raises her eyes to the soldiers gathered before her, who seem still bewildered and uncertain.
The general of Rancors smiles.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: What kind of battlefield is this... All these Rancors, and not one of you has half the spine of a person who walked in here empty-handed.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: ...If this is your decision, ${PlayerName}, then good. Very good... Hold onto that will. Bear her well, and get off my ground.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: ...Don't ever come back.

She sheathes her sword and moves forward, past the two of you, toward her soldiers. Along the way, she collects the discarded pair of Rancor blades—gathering everything, everyone—and retreats deep into their bastion.
You're left where you are. Jasmine trembles uncontrollably, no strength left to chase after the Shattered Blade. She's so broken she can't even pull free from your arms.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: ...Let go... Let go of me... Don't do this...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...I'm sorry, Jasmine... I'm so sorry...
The calls of your MBCC subordinates reach you, and at last, ease settles in. You slacken, your hold gradually releasing. The sounds recede. Before your eyes, a blur of light begins to glow.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: ...You... what's wrong? Hey... Hey!! Wake up!! Chief... CHIEF!!
[Black Screen] Sound of a body collapsing
[Both major branches converge here - Black Screen Transition]

The sandstorm dies down. The MBCC transport vehicle tears away into the distance. Neither side impedes the other, but no one exchanges another word either. It's clear enough now that each has their own road ahead.
Nirvana Port is finally empty of outsiders.
Augustus returns to the command room and sets aside her sword. The expedition was a long one. She brought a few back with her and sent some others on their way. There's much to deal with now.
Behind her, the soldiers who caused the incident stand in a line. They deliver their report as protocol demands, but their voices are a shade too quiet.

steps.speaker: Soldiers
steps.content: General. 32 severely wounded. 29 face a high risk of permanent disability. All have been sent for emergency treatment. 54 Rancor weapons confirmed destroyed, exact count still being tallied. The Mania attached to them likely transferred to that woman's blades.

steps.speaker: Soldiers
steps.content: The MBCC didn't take the weapon. Quartermaster's already on site. Containment will take some time, but we'll handle it.

steps.speaker: Soldiers
steps.content: General...
Augustus keeps her back turned. Her silence alone is torture; the soldiers dare not lift their heads.
After a long, heavy pause, she finally speaks.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: ...Is it really that unbearable, serving under me? You had to go find yourselves a "judge" from outside... What, without her coming to collect your lives, you couldn't even stand being alive?

steps.speaker: Soldiers
steps.content: General, we...

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: You fools!

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Feeling good about yourselves, are you? Playing martyr? You thought that made things right with her? Washed away your sins, gave you release? Open your eyes! Look at what she's become!

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: That woman broke a long time ago. There's nothing you can give back to her. All you did was stain her hands again and betray me one more time. That's it. Nothing else!

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: I told you I'd carry everything for you. I told you I'd lead you back to the battlefield, follow you into hell. So why wouldn't you wait? Can't keep up with me anymore?

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Or do you think I can't carry it? That I'm not worthy?

steps.speaker: Soldiers
steps.content: That's not true!
They scramble to explain themselves, but a thunderous crash cuts them short. Augustus drives her sword deep into the concrete floor. Cracks spider out from the impact. Every voice dies.
The general's blade strikes no one. Her true rage is only buried in the ground. The soldiers know, and their regret only cuts deeper.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: ...Anyone who wants out, go register. The rest of you, get back to cleaning up the battlefield.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: As for those fools... treat the ones who can be saved. The ones who can't... bring them back to me.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: ...I'll send them off myself.
The general dismisses her soldiers. She goes to the cemetery, then returns, walking alone through the ruins.
She does this every time she comes back from a long journey.

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: It's on me. I failed to stop them.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: ...You wouldn't have stopped them. You're no different from them.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: This one's on me. I kept you all waiting too long. I came back too late...

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: General...

Augustus walks on in silence, the wind and sand coursing through the military port as they have for decades without change. Uris recalls it well that 12 years ago, when she came back, it was no different.

A general who was far too young for the battlefield. A color too brilliant against the grey ruins. The one sword that remains forever sharp amid the Shattered Blade. She should have rushed forward into the future without a backward glance, yet she chose to gather up the broken blades and stay behind, anchored to what was.

Should one mock her for such pride? Nirvana Port's shadow rests upon Augustus, as does the Rancors' wails she vowed to shoulder. So immense a burden that even one as iron-willed as she might find herself crushed and consumed by it.
Augustus tilts her head upward. DisCity cannot be glimpsed from this place. Whatever she beholds beyond remains unknown.
Then, all at once, she laughs. One swing of her sword sends a wind that splits sand from sky. The horizon cracks open with light. It's always like this. She turns and gives a casual wave of her hand.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Let's go back. I just said it, didn't I? The battlefield doesn't deal in conscience. I only look at victory. And what comes next.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: The debts of the past... I'll settle them all in time.
Right. What's the hurry? She's pointed out the road ahead. The price still owed is waiting down that path, too. She just needs to keep walking.
She is a general. She will carry it all.
